limits: Opt-in bounded local implementation, not broad production deployment.

No blanket qualification of other MIRIX APIs/caches/extraction pipelines.
A legacy age-cleanup transaction touching an admitted row can fail on the restrictive FK; broader governed removal/retention lifecycle remains deferred.
Preference precedence remains deferred; source classes survive compilation without overriding Task constraints.
